### Summary of New Content
Create a README.md in the docs/ folder as the single entry point for OctoAcme Project Management Docs.
- Introduce OctoAcme’s project management approach
- Briefly summarize the key project management processes
- List and link to every doc in the folder with a short description of each

### Why is this update needed?
There is no single index or summary for all OctoAcme process docs. A README will:
- Help new and existing team members onboard quickly
- Create a one-stop entry point for project management processes
- Improve discoverability and navigation between related docs

### Suggested Content (example README)

# OctoAcme Project Management Documentation

Welcome to the OctoAcme Project Management Docs — your central reference for every process, template, and best practice at OctoAcme.

## Process Summary
OctoAcme's project management approach is:
- Customer-first and iterative: Each project follows a lifecycle — Initiation → Planning → Execution → Release → Retrospective.
- Clear ownership and roles: Project Manager, Product Lead, Developers all have defined responsibilities.
- Incremental delivery: Deliver features in small, testable chunks, with CI/CD and code review required.
- Quality and risk focus: Use automated and manual QA, keep risks visible, escalate blockers early.
- Transparent communication: Regular team syncs, PM updates, and retrospectives for improvement.

## Documentation Index
- [Project Management Overview](octoacme-project-management-overview.md) — Principles, roles, and core artifacts
- [Project Initiation Guide](octoacme-project-initiation.md) — One-pager & starting checklist
- [Project Planning](octoacme-project-planning.md) — Planning and backlog building
- [Execution & Tracking](octoacme-execution-and-tracking.md) — Day-to-day workflow and tracking
- [Release & Deployment Guide](octoacme-release-and-deployment.md) — Release prep, checklist, and incident response
- [Retrospective & Continuous Improvement](octoacme-retrospective-and-continuous-improvement.md) — Running and tracking retrospectives
- [Risk Management & Communication](octoacme-risks-and-communication.md) — Risk register and status updates
- [Roles & Personas](octoacme-roles-and-personas.md) — OctoAcme role definitions

## How to Use
- New team member? Start with the Overview.
- Kicking off a new project? Read Initiation and Planning docs.
- Find a specific process above, and contribute using the templates provided!
